claude.description: Claude Code CLI (cloud). Agent models come from each agent's frontmatter.

opencode.description: opencode + Ollama, fully local. Small models get one role each and the harness orchestrates the pipeline.

hybrid.description: One route per agent (see harness/backends.py). Claude where judgment decides the result, local where a deterministic check backs the agent up. Chosen from harness/eval.py sweeps; see docs/hybrid.md.
hybrid.escalation_why: system evals: the local implementer does single-file changes but loops on multi-file plans (imports modules it never created). One local fix attempt, then Haiku takes the fix with the exact gate output.

tolerance_why.implementer: backed by gate.sh, the reviewer, the fix loop and run.py's re-check: a weaker model costs a fix iteration, not a wrong result
tolerance_why.visual-qa: backed by deterministic OCR (--expect) that run.py re-runs; vision is the second layer
tolerance_why.planner, reviewer, test-writer: 0: nothing deterministic checks them. A bad plan is the contract everyone follows, the reviewer is the last judge, and a test that cannot catch its bug still passes the gate
